channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Article: The Agent Harness: What It Is and Two Ways to Build One
item.description: This article explains the development and operational layers of an agent harness through two implementations of a finance assistant: AWS AgentCore Harness and LangChain with Envoy AI Gateway. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Billing and Cost Management now provides billing context for your account through a new API
item.description: AWS Billing and Cost Management now offers the ListBillingViewSegments API, which returns the billing context of your account over a time period you specify. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EventBridge relaunches event buses for enterprise scale
item.description: Amazon EventBridge relaunches event buses with a new enhanced Custom event bus that lets you build event-driven applications that decouple teams and can scale with your organization. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud region
item.description: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud. Lambda durable functions enable developers to build reliable multi-step applications and AI workflows within the Lambda developer experience. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon RDS for MySQL announces Extended Support minor versions 5.7.44-rds.20260902 and 8.0.46-rds.20260908
item.description: Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) for MySQL announces Amazon RDS Extended Support minor versions 5.7.44-rds.20260902 and 8.0.46-rds.20260908. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL now supports PostgreSQL 19 Beta 4 in the Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment
item.description: Starting today, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 19 Beta 4 is available in the Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment , allowing you to evaluate the pre-release of PostgreSQL 19 on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL now supports post-quantum TLS key exchange
item.description: Starting today, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL introduces support for post-quantum TLS (PQ-TLS) key exchange, providing you with post-quantum cryptography options for encrypting your data in-transit. (1 source: aws)
